history.summary: A neighbourhood Shiva temple at Sector 4/A, G Road, Gandhinagar. It is well-reviewed (4.6 stars, ~350 reviews) and serves as a local centre for pujas, aartis, prasad and festival gatherings; it is especially active on Maha Shivratri with night-long worship reported. UNVERIFIED: no reliable web source gives a founding date, patron, or history - this is a modern locality shrine, not the famous Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga of Madhya Pradesh (Omkareshwar Road station / Khandwa / Indore pages refer to that Jyotirlinga and must not be confused with this temple). Documented from business/directory listings only; coordinates from place-listing data. OPENING HOURS NOTE: justdial, yappe and Instagram place data agree on 5:00 AM-9:00 PM daily; one review site reports 8:30 AM-10:00 PM - verify.

name: Omkareshwar Mahadev Temple, Gandhinagar
town_description: Gandhinagar is the capital of Gujarat and a planned city on the west bank of the Sabarmati river, about 25 km north of Ahmedabad. Laid out in a grid of numbered sectors with wide green avenues, it houses the Gujarat Vidhan Sabha and Secretariat, along with the Akshardham complex, the Children's Park, and Indroda Nature Park. It is Gujarat's administrative and institutional hub and a convenient base for temple tourism in north-central Gujarat.
